## Summary

Describe what changed and why.

## Validation

- [ ] Relevant automated tests pass.
- [ ] Manual verification is documented when automation is not practical.
- [ ] Terraform changes include a reviewed remote plan.

## Security and Operations

- [ ] No credentials, tokens, personal data, or private operational details are included.
- [ ] New GitHub Actions are pinned to immutable commit SHAs.
- [ ] Production-impacting changes include rollback or mitigation notes.
- [ ] Documentation distinguishes real evidence from examples or target-state practices.
